cards.prompt: For $\ce{N2(g) + 3 H2(g) <=> 2 NH3(g)}$ at $\pu{25 °C}$, how does increasing pressure shift equilibrium (化学平衡)?
cards.answer: Toward ammonia because the product side has fewer gas moles.
cards.hint: Compare total gas moles on both sides using `Le Chatelier`.
cards.explanation: Reactants have 4 mol gas while products have 2 mol gas, so higher pressure favors $\ce{NH3}$.
cards.misconception: Assuming pressure only affects liquid volume.

options.explanation: Fewer moles of gas on the right.
